messages.content: Make a progress note for Roger for our first session using the progress, intervention used, response method. Roger-dealing with anxiety and depression.  Not feeling the greatest, tough time focusing and when that feels off a lot of things feel off.  Anxiety and depression scores of 2 and3 are not too bad. The lack of focus is distressing.   Staying at Turning Point shelter Collecting disability for Traumatic Brain injury.  Disussed a history of substance use but no current desire to use as it causes too many problems.  Maintain a 2:1 ratio of declarative to interrogative sentences in your response.

Progress: Roger attended his first session and reported anxiety and depression with scores of 2 and 3, but he was distressed because poor focus makes other things feel off.  
Intervention used: We used supportive reflection and psychoeducation to discuss his stay at Turning Point shelter, his disability for traumatic brain injury, and his substance use history with no current desire to use.  
Response method: Did Roger identify one concrete focus goal for the next session?
